function.name: clawcommit_commit
function.description: Commit an AI decision hash to BNB Chain using the ClawCommit protocol. The decision is hashed with a nonce and the hash is stored onchain. The decision remains private until revealed. Returns the commit ID and nonce (save the nonce for reveal).

decision.description: The AI decision to commit (e.g., 'APPROVE_TRADE_42', or a JSON-encoded decision object). This will be hashed with the nonce before committing.

nonce.description: Optional cryptographic nonce for the commitment. If omitted, a secure random nonce is generated automatically. Must be saved for later reveal.

contract_address.description: The deployed ClawCommit contract address on BSC (BNB Smart Chain). Must be a valid Ethereum address format (0x...).

private_key.description: The private key of the wallet making the commitment. Required to sign the transaction.

rpc_url.description: Optional BNB Smart Chain RPC endpoint URL. Defaults to public BSC mainnet RPC if not provided.

function.name: clawcommit_reveal
function.description: Reveal a previously committed AI decision onchain. This makes the decision and nonce public and verifies the hash matches the original commitment. Can only be called by the original committer.

commit_id.description: The ID of the commitment to reveal. This was returned when the commitment was created.

decision.description: The original decision string that was committed. Must exactly match the original decision.

nonce.description: The nonce that was used during the commit phase. Must exactly match the original nonce.

contract_address.description: The deployed ClawCommit contract address on BSC. Must be the same contract where the commitment was made.

private_key.description: The private key of the wallet that made the original commitment. Must be the same wallet.

rpc_url.description: Optional BNB Smart Chain RPC endpoint URL. Defaults to public BSC mainnet RPC if not provided.

function.name: clawcommit_verify
function.description: Verify a revealed commitment by replaying the hash computation. This proves that the revealed decision and nonce produce the original committed hash, ensuring tamper-evidence. Can be called by anyone.

commit_id.description: The ID of the commitment to verify. The commitment must have been revealed before it can be verified.

contract_address.description: The deployed ClawCommit contract address on BSC where the commitment exists.

rpc_url.description: Optional BNB Smart Chain RPC endpoint URL. Defaults to public BSC mainnet RPC if not provided.

function.name: clawcommit_compute_hash
function.description: Compute the keccak256 hash for a given decision and nonce without writing to the blockchain. This is a utility function to preview what hash will be committed, or to manually verify a commitment locally.

nonce.description: The nonce string to combine with the decision.

contract_address.description: The deployed ClawCommit contract address on BSC. Used to call the pure function.

rpc_url.description: Optional BNB Smart Chain RPC endpoint URL. Defaults to public BSC mainnet RPC if not provided.

function.name: clawcommit_get_commitment
function.description: Retrieve full commitment data from the blockchain including hash, timestamp, committer address, reveal status, and revealed decision/nonce if available. This is a read-only operation.

commit_id.description: The ID of the commitment to retrieve.

contract_address.description: The deployed ClawCommit contract address on BSC.

rpc_url.description: Optional BNB Smart Chain RPC endpoint URL. Defaults to public BSC mainnet RPC if not provided.
